goal: Allow non-standard scripts into testnet mempools when configured with -acceptnonstdtxn=1
Let developers relay and test experimental script opcodes without mining them directly into blocks
agreement: Broad support across approach and implementation, with multiple ACKs
Contested objection that enabling upgradable opcodes exceeds Knots behavior (luke-jr)
Verified by testing compiler enforcement and standardness checks on a BIP 448 branch (instagibbs)
Code approval with a remaining suggestion to add a non-mandatory script relay test (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it helps developers test experimental opcodes and soft forks in testnet mempools
Benefit is focused on developer testing workflows and does not affect mainnet policy
